newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Bimantara Q1 '97 net profit up 17 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bimantara Q1 '97 net profit up 17 pct.

text.p: Indonesian conglomerate Bimantara Citra said on Thursday its net profit for first quarter 1997 was 17 percent higher than the same 1996 period.
"Our net profit in first quarter 1997 is 17 percent higher than the same period last year," Kadir Assegaff, director of Bimantara, told Reuters.

He was speaking after a signing ceremony between Bimantara and South Korea's Hyundai Motor Co to create a joint venture company, PT Bimantara Hyundai Indonesia, to produce sedan cars and commercial vehicles.
Assegaff declined to give details on the company results.
The company posted a net profit of 157.51 billion rupiah in 1996.
Bimantara is controlled by President Suharto's second son Bambang Trihatmojo.
The company is diversified conglomerate involved in transportation, broadcasting and telecommunications.
